items: Developed web application interfaces based on UI/UX designs.
Established a reusable project foundation to streamline development for future features and applications.
Adopted Quasar CLI in the web application development workflow to improve consistency and reduce implementation issues.
Coordinated frontend development tasks based on project manager requirements.
Managed frontend development activities and prepared features for quality assurance (QA) testing.
Developed seller order management, product integration, and omnichannel package features to improve sales operations.
Implemented omnichannel activation features to support channel integration.
Integrated Nuxt.js into the existing web application to support the frontend development workflow.
Collaborated with backend developers to deliver new features and reported development progress to the project manager.

Developed course administration, course review, and discussion features for OCademy, improving the learning experience and contributing to a 20% increase in course sales; also integrated the affiliate plugin on the OCademy WordPress site.
Built a whitelist ads request form and monitoring dashboard to streamline submissions and track request data.
Developed API endpoints to track and update submissions using receipt numbers, implemented a webhook for Facebook login integration, and built an n8n workflow to process WhatsApp Meta analytics data.
Contributed to Cekat AI's OChat application, a chatbot-powered app for creating and managing orders, using Vue.js and Laravel.
Collaborated with the Satuinbox team to develop internal Next.js applications for managing logistics-related support tickets.
Collaborated with backend developers to deliver new features and reported development progress to the project manager.
Developed and maintained Satuinbox, an omnichannel customer service platform built with Next.js and Socket.IO to support customer interactions across channels such as WhatsApp and Instagram.
Implemented server-side rendering (SSR) and client-side data fetching to optimize page load performance and SEO.
Developed REST API endpoints with NestJS and MongoDB, working with controllers, services, DTOs, request validation, and data queries.
Integrated frontend applications with the NestJS APIs, handling authentication, error states, and loading states.
Managed state for live chat and ticketing features, including real-time UI updates and data synchronization with Socket.IO.
Built reusable UI components, validated ticket submission forms, and dashboards visualizing agent performance metrics and ticket statistics.
Contributed to the overhaul and maintenance of the Genesis Apps booking flow using Vue.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Developed reusable, type-safe UI components with configurable props to keep the booking flow consistent and reduce code duplication.
Implemented complex booking business logic and multi-step form state, integrating the frontend with backend APIs.

Refactored legacy booking modules into maintainable, type-safe Vue.js and TypeScript components, fixed critical frontend bugs, and ran manual regression tests to improve stability and cross-browser reliability.
